Field Shift: text review

Thank you for helping! Field Shift is an app for Nile Delta farmers. Below is every text in it. For each one: is this wording OK? Press Yes to keep it, or No, change it and write what it should say. It takes about 10 to 15 minutes, and you can stop and come back.

شكراً لمساعدتك! ده تطبيق لمزارعي دلتا النيل. تحت كل النصوص اللي فيه. لكل نص اضغط Yes لو الكلام مظبوط، أو No, change it واكتب الصيغة اللي تحبها.

Your name / اسمك:

Words in {dashed boxes} are numbers and names the app fills in. Keep them where they make sense. Your answers save in this browser as you go.

When you finish

Write your name at the top, then press Send my answers and pick WhatsApp or Telegram to send them to Tarek. If that does not open, press Download answers and send the file, or Copy answers and paste them in a message.
